llm_summary_material: Process perishable inputs the same day they arrive: coffee cherries must be depulped and fermented within hours of picking or they spoil.
Fix the site before optimizing the machine, because wind yield scales with the cube of wind speed and siting outweighs every downstream design choice.
Respect hard theoretical ceilings before chasing incremental gains: the Betz limit caps any turbine at 59.3%, with real machines at 45–50%.
Match hardware to regional standards instead of assuming uniformity: EV charging splits into CCS (Europe/North America), GB/T (China), and CHAdeMO (Japan).
Add storage to any intermittent source so output survives past daylight: CSP with molten-salt storage delivers after sunset, where plain PV cannot.
Expect learning curves to collapse cost: utility solar fell over 80% from 2010 to 2021, and Li-ion packs dropped from ~$1,100 to under $140 per kWh by 2023.
Keep operating parameters inside the safe envelope: turbines produce from ~3 m/s but shut down near 25 m/s, and green coffee must dry to ~11% moisture before hulling.
Verify with direct measurement rather than inference: the Event Horizon Telescope's 2019 and 2022 images, and the reported ~10% solar-to-fuel efficiency, confirmed what theory alone could not.
